Package index

Render reports

Entry points that render the parameterized QC report templates end-to-end

run_howmahico_report()
Render a HowMaHiCo QC report from the installed package templates
derive_filtered_annotation()
Derive a Condition-filtered copy of a sample annotation file

Annotation

Read, validate, and display sample annotation tables

read_annot()
Read, validate, and reformat a sample annotation table
print_annot()
Render an annotation table as an interactive HTML datatable

Data loaders

Software-specific loader families that converge on the unified pep_all schema

fp_read_psm_batch()
Batch-read every FragPipe psm.tsv under a folder and merge them
fp_parse_pep_all()
Parse raw FragPipe PSM results into pep_all format
fp_annotate()
Join parsed FragPipe results to the sample annotation table
diann_read_tsv_batch()
Batch-read every DIA-NN report.tsv under a folder and merge them
diann_parse_pep_all()
Parse raw DIA-NN report results into pep_all format
diann_annotate()
Join parsed DIA-NN results to the sample annotation table
peaks_read_batch()
Batch-read and annotate every PEAKS export folder into pep_all format

Checks

Guard against clobbering existing output and summarise global ID composition

check_file_exists()
Check whether a single output file already exists
check_output_exists()
Check whether any of the report's standard output files already exist
check_ids_global()
Total ID counts split by protein/decoy/contaminant assignment

Counting & overlap analysis

Tabulate ID counts, charge/area summaries, sequence lists, and cross-condition overlaps

count_ids()
Count distinct peptides, sequences, and proteins
count_ids_condition_bylengthrange()
ID counts and proportions by Length_range and Condition
count_ids_by()
Wide table of peptide identifications by an arbitrary grouping
get_charge_group()
Classify charge states into +1/+2/>= +3 groups
get_proportion_charge()
Proportions of each charge group within a count table
get_mat_log2area()
Build a Log2Area matrix for clustering/heatmaps/correlation
summarise_area()
Per-peptide Area mean/sd/%CV summary by group
list_sequences()
List unique peptide sequences per group
count_intersect()
Count distinct elements shared between two conditions
count_merged()
Count distinct elements across the union of two conditions
count_samples_patients()
Combined per-Patient/Sample_type/Condition sample-and-patient count summary
select_unique()
Select distinct rows on a subset of columns
filter_unique()
Filter rows and drop to distinct/unused-level state

Plotting

QC plots covering ID size/charge distributions, overlaps, motifs, and correlation

plot_peplength_dens()
Peptide length distribution: boxplot + density histogram
plot_pepmass()
Peptide mass distribution: boxplot + density histogram with apex annotation
plot_pepmz()
Peptide m/z distribution: boxplot + density histogram with apex annotation
plot_bp_count_length()
Stacked bar chart of total ID counts per Condition, split by length range
plot_upset()
UpSet plot of overlap between groups for a given variable
plot_upset_batch()
Batch of UpSet plots across several variables
ggseqlogo_bylength()
Sequence motif logo for peptides of a given length
plot_prop_length_condition()
Stacked bar chart of peptide proportions by Length_range and Condition
plot_charge_proportions()
Stacked bar chart of charge-state proportions by group
plot_violin_areacv()
Violin + boxplot of Area %CV by group
plot_corr()
Pearson correlation heatmap of log2(Area)
theme_rawr()
HowMaHiCo's shared ggplot theme

Export & I/O helpers

Write report outputs (plots, csvs, render parameters) to disk

ggsave_rawr()
Save a ggplot to a folder, skipping plots that were never built
ggprint_rawr()
Print a plot, skipping ones that were never built
write.csv_rawr()
Write a data frame to csv, named after the variable that was passed in
write_input_params()
Write a report's render parameters to csv
